_doc: IDWriteFontFile. The hand subclass IDWriteFontFile.ts keeps analyze() with friendly field names (isSupported/fileType/faceType/numberOfFaces); getReferenceKey + getLoader come from the generated base.

IDWriteFontFile.Analyze._why: hand analyze() returns {isSupported, fileType, faceType, numberOfFaces} (friendlier names than the raw param-derived shape); IDWriteFactory.loadFontFace depends on it
